active_read_policy.definition:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (profiles p
     JOIN roles r ON ((r.id = p.role_id)))
  WHERE ((p.id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (p.account_status = 'active'::text) AND (((r.name = 'customer'::text) AND (viewing_requests.customer_id = p.id)) OR ((r.name = ANY (ARRAY['administrator'::text, 'sales_customer_service'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (role_permissions rp
             JOIN permissions pm ON ((pm.id = rp.permission_id)))
          WHERE ((rp.role_id = p.role_id) AND (pm.name = 'viewings.view'::text)))))))))

notification_event_index.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notifications_one_viewing_event_recipient ON public.notifications USING btree (((metadata ->> 'viewing_event_id'::text)), recipient_id) WHERE ((related_entity_type = 'viewing_request'::text) AND (metadata ? 'viewing_event_id'::text))
